module.purpose: Implements React reconciler's exception path: handling Suspense wakeables and render errors, marking boundaries to capture, and scheduling recovery updates.
module.summary: This file is part of React's fiber reconciler and contains the logic for what happens when a component throws during render, either by suspending (returning a thenable) or by raising an error. It provides functions to construct root and class error updates, reset suspended components' state, mark Suspense/Offscreen boundaries to capture the suspension, and the central throwException function that walks the fiber tree to find an error boundary or Suspense handler, dealing with hydration, legacy vs concurrent mode, and ping listeners. It does not define any classes but exports several helper functions used by the work loop.
module.businessContext: Core internals of React rendering. If broken, apps crash on errors or Suspense never shows fallbacks. Critical for UI resilience.
